# RINLock

> Linux runtime detection, explicit eBPF prevention, and vulnerability scanning. Terminal dashboard and local Unix API.

Version: 0.5.0-dev. Source commit: e73177aff5f478708367d9c1eb71cbc402ec8c85. This documentation is a published development snapshot. Source repository is private.

## Current guides

- [RINLock](https://merl111.github.io/RINLock-docs/index.md): Project overview and documentation entry points
- [Getting started](https://merl111.github.io/RINLock-docs/getting-started.md): Build, demo, deployment and feature overview
- [Architecture](https://merl111.github.io/RINLock-docs/docs/architecture.md): Collector, daemon, storage and trust boundaries
- [Configuration](https://merl111.github.io/RINLock-docs/docs/configuration.md): Detection, retention and notification settings
- [CLI and API](https://merl111.github.io/RINLock-docs/docs/reference.md): Commands, Unix sockets, request methods and event contracts
- [Deployment and operations](https://merl111.github.io/RINLock-docs/docs/stage-3.md): Services, recovery, storage and delivery operations; historical measurements are labelled
- [Runtime prevention](https://merl111.github.io/RINLock-docs/docs/prevention.md): BPF LSM policy, permissions and failure semantics
- [Vulnerability scanning](https://merl111.github.io/RINLock-docs/docs/vulnerabilities.md): Trivy, KEV, coverage, asynchronous jobs and findings
- [Agent integration](https://merl111.github.io/RINLock-docs/docs/agents.md): Machine-readable entry points and reliable automation recipes
- [Testing and releases](https://merl111.github.io/RINLock-docs/docs/releasing.md): Validation gates and release artifacts
- [Security model](https://merl111.github.io/RINLock-docs/SECURITY.md): Assumptions, limitations and reporting
- [Configuration examples](https://merl111.github.io/RINLock-docs/configs/index.md): Downloadable JSON examples and validation references

## Machine-readable resources

- [Full context](https://merl111.github.io/RINLock-docs/llms-full.txt): Current guides in one Markdown bundle
- [Manifest](https://merl111.github.io/RINLock-docs/agent-manifest.json): Version, commit and resource SHA-256 digests
